title: White Sands near-Earth satellite search led by LaPaz and Tombaugh
summary: Jesse Michels tells of White Sands near-Earth satellite search led by LaPaz and Tombaugh, about 1953-1954 at White Sands and Holloman, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico

tellings.quote: That same year, a very unusual project started at White Sands Missile Range.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1953 a very unusual project began at White Sands Missile Range, a military testing ground in New Mexico. As he tells it, two scientists, Lincoln LaPaz and Clyde Tombaugh, led a search for unknown small objects circling close to Earth, and he points to the project's final report. If true, it would mean the military took seriously the idea that something was already orbiting our planet.
